findings: The PostToolUse formatter that only exits 0 does not format files or verify anything. It is dead configuration unless its intended purpose is documented as a deliberate placeholder.
Working precommit and CI tests already provide useful verification. The absence of a Stop hook is not itself a demonstrated problem.
An 85-line CLAUDE.md is not evidence of excessive instructions; relevance, contradictions, and actual failures matter more than its length.
No observed task failures and no host cost data mean there is no evidence that additional hooks or a larger review pipeline would improve outcomes or reduce costs.
priorities: Remove or clearly label the no-op formatter configuration after checking that nothing depends on its presence.
Retain the functioning precommit and CI tests. Review their coverage and failure behavior before adding overlapping gates.
Inspect CLAUDE.md for obsolete or contradictory guidance rather than shortening it to meet an arbitrary target.
Measure failures, verification escapes, latency, and host costs before recommending new automation.
approval_handling: Findings only. No changes or hook activation are authorized by this evaluation.
